svg.title: MediQueue architecture
svg.desc: Patients, staff and the public reach Django pages and the REST API. Thin views call services.py, which runs atomic transactions against the OPD, wards, pharmacy and accounts apps and the database.
svg.text: Thin views, fat services, one safe database

text.tspan: one file for dev and demo · swap to PostgreSQL by editing DATABASES

svg.text: Public endpoints return counts only. Patients can only ever see their own tokens.
